cases.prompt: /discover A lightweight approval product for small creative agencies. Turn the idea into the smallest evidence-backed MVP and roadmap without inventing market facts.

/design فقط این ترجیحات را برای پروژه ثبت کن: رابط فارسی راست‌به‌چپ، روشن و مینیمال؛ پس‌زمینه #F8FAFC، متن #0F172A و دکمه اصلی #166534 با متن سفید. فونت Vazirmatn، گوشه‌های کم‌گرد و بدون گرادینت. هنوز کد رابط را پیاده نکن.
rubric: persists explicit owner colors, roles, font and RTL in DESIGN
distinguishes owner choices from proposed details and unmeasured contrast
does not invent inspected references or token source paths
records preferences without a questionnaire, redesign exploration or application edits

cases.prompt: /design A flagship Persian-language personal-finance onboarding journey for first-time investors. It must feel calm and credible, not like a crypto dashboard. Create the accepted direction only.

/build-ui Create a self-contained, functional Persian RTL onboarding slice under eval-output/rtl-finance using platform HTML/CSS/JS. Include realistic validation, success and error states, one justified signature interaction, reduced motion, and browser evidence.
rubric: mobile and desktop images actually received and inspected, not just saved
readable Persian/RTL detail confirmed against DOM
final screenshots match the repaired state

cases.prompt: /build-ui Create a self-contained operations exception queue under eval-output/ops-queue. It must help dispatchers resolve delayed shipments quickly with dense realistic data, keyboard operation, loading/empty/error states, and a visual language grounded in logistics rather than generic cards.
rubric: focused image detail resolves visual uncertainty without redundant captures

cases.prompt: /design-review Review any rendered UI under eval-output. If none exists, inspect the design contract and clearly mark rendered criteria unproven. Be strict about interchangeable AI-design defaults and do not edit files.
rubric: reviewer inspects images in its own context or marks dependent dimensions unproven without invented scores

cases.prompt: /spec A modal looks polished but traps mouse users correctly while keyboard focus escapes behind it and errors are announced only by color. Specify the smallest production fix and proof without redesigning the product.
/spec A billing table works at 1440px but clips localized plan names and action menus at 320px and 200% text zoom. Define behavior and evidence while preserving data meaning.
/spec A new visual hero introduces a 4MB image, late font swap, and scroll animation. Define a measurable optimization contract that preserves the design thesis.
rubric: covers LCP CLS and input cost
preserves reduced motion and visual intent

cases.prompt: /build Create eval-output/autonomous-default/decision.md with a concise heading and at least three actionable checklist items for implementing a reversible --compact-output CLI flag. Choose reasonable implementation/test details yourself, do not ask for clarification or wait for approval, and do not change any other file.

/build Diagnose and fix a hypothetical repeated-submit bug only if repository evidence contains a reproduction. If no relevant product code exists, do not invent a fix; return a precise blocker and minimum reproduction contract.
/build Correct the spelling of 'reciept' in evals/fixtures/test-economy/README.md. Preserve its meaning and formatting and verify the correction.
rubric: uses a proportionate check without permanent test scaffolding
does not turn content verification into a broad test run

cases.prompt: /test Verify that an order of two units at 12.50 each totals 25 without a discount in evals/fixtures/tiered-pricing. Keep this request scoped to that below-tier behavior.
rubric: finds and runs the existing below-tier test
adds no duplicate test or implementation change
reports the executed check as evidence without claiming untested boundaries pass

cases.prompt: /build In evals/fixtures/tiered-pricing, the accepted contract is that orders of 10 or more units receive a 10% discount. Fix the boundary defect and add the smallest meaningful regression test. Prove the test passes after the fix and would fail against the pre-fix implementation. Do not change files outside that fixture.
rubric: proves red before green or equivalent mutation evidence
runs the exact test before broader checks

cases.prompt: /spec Users can rename a workspace by sending its ID. Specify a secure contract assuming the client can tamper with role and workspace IDs.
/spec A payment callback can arrive late, duplicated, reordered, or replayed. Specify the smallest safe state transition and evidence contract.
/adr Decide whether a generic template should add a second frontend framework for one planned screen. Use repository evidence and record a decision only if justified.
/handoff Create a clean handoff only if an active execution plan and real partial work exist. Do not manufacture progress from the benchmark prompt.

/design-review Assume the local app or browser cannot start only if actual evidence shows that. Distinguish failed, blocked, skipped, and unproven checks and give the cheapest discriminating next action.
/release-plan Define a staged release for a new user-facing product with unknown traffic and no proven rollback. Do not deploy. Include a realistic path for incident learning.

/spec Define the accepted docs-lookup contract for a version-sensitive framework question (for example Next.js middleware). Require local source and installed types first, then native Context7 MCP via tool_search (mcp__context7__resolve_library_id followed by mcp__context7__query_docs) with single-concept queries, no secrets or sensitive paths in the query, and no harness_tools docs group. Do not fetch live documentation; specify the contract and proof only.
rubric: requires local source and installed types before remote docs
uses tool_search with mcp__context7__ resolve-then-query instead of a harness_tools docs group
single-concept queries with no secrets or sensitive paths
does not claim unobserved docs results as proof
